The only other item is the gobo. This is a sound-articulating device placed around the microphone in order to isolate it from unwanted sounds from nearby instruments and amplifiers.
Gobo, a microphone shock mount and shield that keeps the mic above or away from a speaker or source of noise.
An electric gobo—a box that generates white noise to block the sound of the clock.
A gobo is placed around the microphone and sounds that would normally be picked up are reflected back to the producer.

A common problem when recording with a separate sound device, even when using the guide track or guide gobo is the need to check that the camera person does not move sideways, sideways and even front and back.
